C.A.M.P./non-shared-color-tap-makes-coun: The ETB/tap trigger's 'If that creature shares a color with the mana that land produced, create a Junk token' is a Condition gate the engine does not evaluate: the shared-color check is skipped and the Junk token is always created. The shared-color sibling scenario passes because W/G also share there -- this row is the only half that diverges.
